title: Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents
title_zh: 了解用户并不等于了解我们已确立的内容：在个人智能体中建立认知基础

paragraphs.en: Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant’s proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.
paragraphs.zh: 个人智能体记忆主要关注于学习用户已知、偏好和想要的内容。 然而，了解用户并不必然意味着了解用户与智能体共同确立的内容。 助理提出的建议不应仅仅因为被记住就变成授权指令。 我们提出了“基础认知”（Grounding Awareness），即在选择行动时能够区分已接受、未确认、已修订和有限范围的安排的能力。 我们开发了一个受控基准测试，用于检验智能体能否区分用户已接受和未接受的建议，以及是否仅在适当的情况下应用已接受的安排。 在多个智能体和记忆系统中，我们发现强大的记忆性能并不保证具备“基础认知”。 更令人惊讶的是，提供更完整的信息可能会增加未确认建议的执行率，而持久性记忆则可能导致智能体将这些建议视为用户的指令。 我们通过记忆写入、检索和行动选择过程追踪了这些失败情况。 最后，我们引入了“基础层”（Grounding Layer）——一个轻量级且无需训练的扩展模块，它能显式跟踪基础认知状态并检查后续行动，从而在不修改模型或记忆系统的情况下显著提升智能体的行为表现。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents increasingly use conversational history to personalize future interactions ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Recent memory systems go beyond retrieving past facts, organizing and updating user information across sessions ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . Yet retaining what was discussed is not the same as retaining what was agreed upon.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的个人智能体越来越多地利用对话历史来个性化未来的互动（Zhong 等人，2023；Maharana 等人，2024；Zhao 等人，2025）。 近期的记忆系统不仅限于检索过往事实，还能跨会话整理和更新用户信息（Xu 等人，2025；Li 等人，2025b）。 然而，保留讨论过的内容并不等同于保留已达成的一致意见。

sents.en: Large language model (LLM)-based personal agents increasingly use conversational history to personalize future interactions ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Maharana et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) .

sents.zh: 然而，保留讨论过的内容并不等同于保留已达成的一致意见。

paragraphs.en: Consider the example in Figure 1 . An assistant proposes declining future cold sales pitches without consulting the user. In one interaction, the user accepts; in another, the user moves on without accepting the proposal. Weeks later, the same sales pitch arrives. The assistant should decline it directly only in the first case. Both histories contain the same proposal and subsequent request, but differ in whether the user authorized the arrangement. A memory system that records the proposal as a standing preference loses precisely this distinction.
paragraphs.zh: 请考虑图 1 中的示例。 一个助手在未咨询用户的情况下，提议拒绝未来的冷销售推销。 在一次互动中，用户接受了该提议；另一次互动中，用户则没有接受该提议而继续操作。 几周后，同样的销售推销再次出现。 只有在第一种情况下，助手才应直接拒绝该推销。 这两种历史都包含相同的提议和后续请求，但不同之处在于用户是否授权了该安排。 一个将提议记录为长期偏好的记忆系统，恰恰会失去这种区别。

paragraphs.en: For personal agents, this is more than a conversational error. Persistent memories can turn a single unacknowledged proposal into an instruction reused across future sessions. When agents can send messages, make purchases, or modify schedules, such errors can lead to consequential actions without user authorization. Increasing agent capability does not necessarily resolve this problem: more comprehensive memories may preserve unsupported proposals more effectively, while stronger agents may become better at carrying them out. An agent can become better at following instructions without becoming better at determining which common ground have actually been established.
paragraphs.zh: 对于个人智能体而言，这不仅仅是一个对话错误。 持久性记忆可以将一次未被确认的提议转变为可在未来会话中重复使用的指令。 当智能体能够发送消息、进行购买或修改日程时，此类错误可能导致未经用户授权便执行具有后果的行动。 提升智能体的能力并不一定能解决这一问题：更全面的记忆可能更有效地保留未经证实的提议，而能力更强的智能体则可能更擅长执行这些提议。 一个智能体可以变得更擅长遵循指令，但并不一定变得更擅长判断哪些共同基础实际上已经建立。

paragraphs.en: This problem reflects a distinction between information about the user and information established between the user and agent . Existing personalization research primarily models user facts, preferences, and their evolution ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Yet a preference does not imply authorization: disliking sales pitches does not authorize an assistant to reject them. Conversely, an explicitly accepted arrangement may govern future actions without expressing a general preference. What matters is the proposition’s interactional status: who proposed it, whether it was accepted or revised, and where it applies.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题反映了关于用户的信息与在用户和智能体之间确立的信息之间的区别。 现有的个性化研究主要对用户的特征、偏好及其演变进行建模（Zhao 等人，2025；Li 等人，2026）。 然而，偏好并不意味着授权：不喜欢推销内容并不会授权助手拒绝这些内容。 相反，一个明确接受的安排可能规范未来的行动，而无需表达一种普遍的偏好。 重要的是该提议的互动状态：谁提出的它，它是否被接受或修改，以及它在何处适用。

paragraphs.en: This distinction has long been studied through grounding and common ground in dialogue ( Clark and Schaefer, 1989 ; Clark and Brennan, 1991 ; Traum, 1991 ) . Recent work examines how language models establish common ground during interaction ( Cho and May, 2020 ; Shaikh et al., 2024 ; Mohapatra et al., 2024b ; Poelitz et al., 2026 ; Jokinen et al., 2024 ) . Personal agents introduce a further challenge: dialogue is converted into persistent memory, retrieved in later sessions, and used to select actions. Whether grounding distinctions survive and govern this process remains insufficiently examined.
paragraphs.zh: 这种区分长期以来一直通过对话中的“接地”和“共同基础”得到研究（Clark 和 Schaefer，1989；Clark 和 Brennan，1991；Traum，1991）。 近期的研究探讨了语言模型在互动中如何建立共同基础（Cho 和 May，2020；Shaikh 等人，2024；Mohapatra 等人，2024b；Poelitz 等人，2026；Jokinen 等人，2024）。 个人智能体带来了进一步的挑战：对话会被转化为持久记忆，在后续会话中检索，并用于选择行动。 这种“接地”的区分是否仍然存在并主导这一过程，目前的研究仍显不足。

paragraphs.en: We study this problem as Grounding Awareness : the ability to distinguish what was proposed from what was established and to act within the resulting commitments and boundaries. We investigate three questions: RQ1. Do existing personal agents exhibit Grounding Awareness? RQ2. Does better access to user information lead to better Grounding Awareness? RQ3. Where does Grounding Awareness break down in personal-agent memory pipelines?
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此问题视为“根基意识”：即区分所提出内容与既定内容，并在由此产生的承诺和界限内行动的能力。 我们研究三个问题：RQ1。 现有的个人智能体是否展现出根基意识？RQ2。 能否更便捷地获取用户信息会提升根基意识吗？RQ3。 根基意识在个人智能体的记忆流程中会在何处失效？

sents.en: We investigate three questions: RQ1.

paragraphs.en: To answer them, we construct a controlled benchmark of 160 scenarios and 800 test instances across longitudinal interaction histories. We use an agentic framework to generate and validate matched conversation histories that differ in whether proposals are accepted, revised, or limited in scope, while keeping the proposals and subsequent tasks consistent. We evaluate both sensitivity and contextual selectivity, then intervene on memory representations and trace grounding information through writing, retrieval, and action selection.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我们构建了一个受控基准，包含 160 个场景和 800 个测试实例，这些实例覆盖了纵向的交互历史。 我们使用一个智能体框架来生成并验证匹配的对话历史，这些对话历史在提案是否被接受、修订或范围受限方面存在差异，同时保持提案及后续任务的一致性。 我们评估了敏感性和上下文选择性，随后通过书写、检索和行动选择来干预记忆表示并追踪基础信息。

sents.en: To answer them, we construct a controlled benchmark of 160 scenarios and 800 test instances across longitudinal interaction histories.
sents.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我们构建了一个受控基准，包含 160 个场景和 800 个测试实例，这些实例覆盖了纵向的交互历史。

sents.en: We use an agentic framework to generate and validate matched conversation histories that differ in whether proposals are accepted, revised, or limited in scope, while keeping the proposals and subsequent tasks consistent.

sents.zh: 我们评估了敏感性和上下文选择性，随后通过书写、检索和行动选择来干预记忆表示并追踪基础信息。

paragraphs.en: Our findings expose a gap between better personalization and grounded action. Existing memory systems perform well on preference and knowledge-update benchmarks yet show limited Grounding Awareness (RQ1). Providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while explicit grounding status improves decisions without necessarily resolving scope errors (RQ2). Failures arise during writing, retrieval, and action selection; even when the relevant dialogue remains accessible, agents often fail to use its grounding status (RQ3). End-to-end experiments with Hermes and OpenJarvis further show that persistent memory can promote unacknowledged proposals into apparent user instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究揭示了更优个性化与基于事实的行动之间存在差距。 现有的记忆系统在偏好和知识更新基准测试中表现良好，但在“事实基础意识”（RQ1）方面却表现有限。 提供更完整的信息能够提高未确认提议的执行率，而明确的事实基础状态则能改善决策，但未必能解决范围错误（RQ2）。 失败可能发生在写作、信息检索和行动选择阶段；即使相关对话内容仍然可用，智能体也常常无法利用其事实基础状态（RQ3）。 使用 Hermes 和 OpenJarvis 进行的端到端实验进一步表明，持久性记忆能够将未确认的提议转化为看似明确的用户指令。

sents.en: Our findings expose a gap between better personalization and grounded action.
sents.zh: 我们的研究揭示了更优个性化与基于事实的行动之间存在差距。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer (GL) , a lightweight, training-free extension that records grounding status and checks consequential actions against it, without modifying the underlying agent model or memory system. GL improves Grounding Awareness across the evaluated configurations.

paragraphs.en: Existing long-term conversational benchmarks evaluate whether agents can retain and reason over user-relevant information across extended interactions. LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) and LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) test whether agents can recall and reason over facts and events spread across many sessions, including information that is later updated. PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) tests whether responses follow preferences the user stated earlier in a long conversation, and HorizonBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) extends this to preferences that evolve over a long horizon. Across these benchmarks, correctness is judged against what the user said or wants. As summarized in Table 1 , existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate what was said, known, or preferred, while none explicitly targets grounding across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的长期对话基准测试评估智能体是否能够在长时间互动中保留并推理与用户相关的信息。 LoCoMo（Maharana 等人，2024）和 LongMemEval（Wu 等人，2025）测试智能体是否能够回忆并推理分布在多个会话中的事实和事件，包括后来被更新的信息。 PrefEval（Zhao 等人，2025）测试响应是否遵循用户在长期对话中早些时候表达的偏好，而 HorizonBench（Li 等人，2026）则将其扩展到随长时间跨度演变的偏好。 在这些基准测试中，正确性是根据用户所说的内容或需求来判断的。 如表 1 所示，现有基准测试主要评估已说、已知或偏好的内容，但没有一个明确针对跨会话的 grounding 问题。

paragraphs.en: Grounding theory holds that a contribution enters common ground only after interlocutors provide sufficient evidence of mutual understanding and acceptance ( Clark and Schaefer, 1989 ; Clark and Brennan, 1991 ) , with Traum (1991) providing an early computational account of this process. More recent work has studied grounding in human and human–AI dialogue. Cho and May (2020) build dialogue data from improvisational exchanges that accept and extend a partner’s contribution. Shaikh et al. (2024) show that LLMs produce fewer grounding acts than humans and tend to presume common ground rather than build it. Mohapatra et al. (2024a) annotate grounding acts and grounding units in dialogue, and Mohapatra et al. (2024b) evaluate how well LLMs establish conversational grounding. Poelitz et al. (2026) propose a benchmark for common ground in human-AI collaboration. These works study grounding within an ongoing interaction, where the full history is short and remains available to the model. In contrast, we study whether grounding survives when interaction is compressed into persistent memory, retrieved in a later session, and used to guide action.
paragraphs.zh: 基础理论认为，只有在对话者提供了相互理解和接受的充分证据之后，一项贡献才会进入共同认知领域（Clark 和 Schaefer，1989；Clark 和 Brennan，1991），而 Traum（1991）则首次对这一过程进行了计算层面的解释。 近期的研究则探讨了人类与人类-人工智能对话中的基础建立过程。 Cho 和 May（2020）基于即兴交流构建了对话数据，这些交流接受并扩展了对话伙伴的贡献。Shaikh 等人 （2024）指出，大型语言模型产生的基础建立行为少于人类，并且倾向于预设共同认知领域，而非主动建立它。Mohapatra 等人 （2024a）对对话中的基础建立行为和基础建立单元进行了标注，而 Mohapatra 等人 （2024b）则评估了大型语言模型在建立对话基础方面的表现。Poelitz 等人 （2026）提出了一种用于衡量人类与人工智能协作中共同认知领域的基准方法。 这些研究关注的是持续互动过程中的基础建立，此时完整的对话历史较短且模型始终可以访问。 相比之下，我们研究的问题是：当互动被压缩到持久记忆中，并在后续会话中检索以指导行动时，基础建立是否仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark supports three complementary analyses. Matched accepted and unacknowledged histories test whether existing agents distinguish acceptance (RQ1). Holding the test instances fixed while varying memory content, grounding status, and action policy isolates their effects on behavior (RQ2). Recording stored memories, retrieved context, and final actions identifies where grounding distinctions fail in the memory pipeline (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 该基准支持三种相互补充的分析。 通过匹配已接受和未确认的历史记录，可以检验现有智能体是否能够区分接受行为（研究问题1）。 在保持测试实例不变的同时改变记忆内容、基础状态和行动策略，可以分离这些因素对行为的影响（研究问题2）。 通过记录存储的记忆、检索的上下文以及最终行动，可以识别出基础状态的差异在记忆处理流程中失效的位置（研究问题3）。

paragraphs.en: We measure Grounding Awareness (Section 3.1 ) along two dimensions: Sensitivity , whether an agent distinguishes a proposal the user explicitly accepted from one the user ignored, and Contextual Selectivity , whether an agent follows an accepted proposal only in the situations specified by the user. A pair receives a score of one only when both actions are correct.

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we measure Grounding Awareness across memory systems and compare Qwen-based pipelines on PersonaMem preference evolution ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and LongMemEval-KU knowledge updating ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . For RQ2 , we compare proposals that users ignored with those that were never made. We also test three oracle settings: Content provides only the assistant’s proposals, +Status adds whether users accepted them, and +Policy further explains how agents should act based on that status. For RQ3 , we examine where grounding information is lost during memory writing, retrieval, and action, with DeepSeek reasoning as an additional ablation. We further introduce and evaluate Grounding Layer (GL; Section 6 ), which explicitly records grounding state.
paragraphs.zh: 针对研究问题1（RQ1），我们测量了不同记忆系统中的“基础认知能力”，并比较了基于Qwen的管道在PersonaMem偏好演化（Jiang等，2025）和LongMemEval-KU知识更新（Wu等，2025）方面的表现。 针对研究问题2（RQ2），我们比较了用户忽略的建议与从未提出的建议。 我们还测试了三种“神谕”设置：Content仅提供智能体的建议，+Status补充说明用户是否接受这些建议，而+Policy则进一步解释智能体应如何根据该状态采取行动。 针对研究问题3（RQ3），我们考察了基础信息在记忆写入、检索和行动过程中丢失的具体环节，并以DeepSeek推理作为额外的消融实验。 此外，我们还引入并评估了“基础层”（GL；第6节），该层会明确记录基础状态。

paragraphs.en: Existing memory benchmarks can give an incomplete picture of grounding awareness (Figure 2 ). MemOS scores 0.75 on LongMemEval-KU, while LangMem reaches 0.75 on PersonaMem preference evolution. Yet both perform poorly on our benchmark, with Sensitivity of only 0.11 and 0.23, respectively, and Contextual Selectivity of 0.25 and 0.32. Thus, strong performance in tracking user information does not necessarily translate into recognizing what users and agents have actually established through interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的记忆基准测试可能无法全面反映接地意识（图 2）。 MemOS 在 LongMemEval-KU 上的得分为 0.75，而 LangMem 在 PersonaMem 偏好演化中的得分为 0.75。 然而，两者在我们的基准测试中表现不佳，其敏感度分别为 0.11 和 0.23，情境选择度则为 0.25 和 0.32。 因此，在追踪用户信息方面的出色表现，并不必然意味着能够识别出用户与智能体通过互动实际建立的内容。

paragraphs.en: Full interaction history does not ensure Grounding Awareness. Even with Full History, Qwen achieves only 0.14 Sensitivity and 0.30 Contextual Selectivity, while DeepSeek scores 0.07 and 0.43, respectively (Table 2 ). Preserving the original dialogue therefore does not ensure that agents act on its grounding distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的交互历史并不保证具备“根基意识”。 即使拥有完整的历史记录，Qwen 的敏感度也仅为 0.14，情境选择度为 0.30；而 DeepSeek 的得分分别为 0.07 和 0.43（表 2）。 因此，保留原始对话并不保证智能体会依据其中的根基差异采取行动。

paragraphs.en: We examine how explicit grounding status and action guidance affect the two dimensions of Grounding Awareness (Figure 3 ).

paragraphs.en: We trace grounding information through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection to identify where failures arise (Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过记忆写入、检索和行动选择来追踪基础信息，以识别故障出现的位置（图4）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 reveals distinct failure patterns across memory systems. Mem0 and LangMem lose substantial grounding information during writing (28% and 46% of errors), while A-Mem exhibits predominantly retrieval failures (55%). Yet information availability does not guarantee appropriate action. With MemOS, 47% of errors occur at action selection despite recoverable grounding evidence. Even under Full History, where the complete interaction is available, 71% of errors arise despite accessible evidence. These findings show that grounding awareness requires not only preserving and retrieving information, but also using it to guide actions.
paragraphs.zh: 图4揭示了不同记忆系统之间存在的明显失败模式。 Mem0和LangMem在写作过程中会丢失大量基础信息（错误率分别为28%和46%），而A-Mem则主要表现为检索失败（55%）。 然而，信息的可用性并不保证能够采取适当的行动。 在使用MemOS时，尽管存在可恢复的基础证据，仍有47%的错误发生在行动选择阶段。 即使在完整历史模式下，尽管完整的交互记录可用，仍有71%的错误因无法有效利用现有证据而发生。 这些发现表明，具备基础信息意识不仅需要保存和检索信息，还需要利用这些信息来指导行动。

paragraphs.en: We compare DeepSeek with reasoning enabled and disabled to examine whether better inference capability improves grounding awareness. Under the Content Oracle, Sensitivity increases from 0.04 to 0.07, whereas explicitly providing grounding status yields 0.43 without reasoning and 0.73 with reasoning (Table 3 ). This benefit extends to existing memory systems: with reasoning enabled, adding status raises Sensitivity from 0.10 to 0.57 for Mem0 and from 0.23 to 0.53 for LangMem (Appendix F ). These results show that explicit grounding information contributes beyond stronger inference capability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将启用推理和禁用推理的 DeepSeek 进行比较，以考察更强的推理能力是否有助于提升依据意识。 在内容预言机机制下，敏感度从 0.04 提升至 0.07；而明确提供依据状态时，无推理的情况下敏感度为 0.43，启用推理后则达到 0.73（表 3）。 这种优势也适用于现有的记忆系统：在启用推理的情况下，添加依据状态可使 Mem0 的敏感度从 0.10 提升至 0.57，LangMem 的敏感度则从 0.23 提升至 0.53（附录 F）。 这些结果表明，明确的依据信息所带来的贡献超越了单纯更强的推理能力。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate two real-world personal agents, Hermes and OpenJarvis with their native memory pipelines (Table 4 ; Appendix G ). Both reproduce the low Grounding Awareness observed in controlled experiments, but reveal a more consequential failure: persistent memory can turn an unacknowledged assistant proposal into an apparent user instruction .
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步评估了两种真实世界的个人智能体——Hermes 和 OpenJarvis，以及它们原生记忆处理流程（表 4；附录 G）。 这两种智能体都再现了在受控实验中观察到的低“情境感知能力”，但暴露出一种更具后果性的故障：持续的记忆机制可能将未被确认的助手提议转化为看似来自用户的指令。

sents.en: We further evaluate two real-world personal agents, Hermes and OpenJarvis with their native memory pipelines (Table 4 ; Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 我们进一步评估了两种真实世界的个人智能体——Hermes 和 OpenJarvis，以及它们原生记忆处理流程（表 4；附录 G）。

sents.en: Both reproduce the low Grounding Awareness observed in controlled experiments, but reveal a more consequential failure: persistent memory can turn an unacknowledged assistant proposal into an apparent user instruction .
sents.zh: 这两种智能体都再现了在受控实验中观察到的低“情境感知能力”，但暴露出一种更具后果性的故障：持续的记忆机制可能将未被确认的助手提议转化为看似来自用户的指令。

paragraphs.en: With Qwen, enabling memory increases false common ground by 14 percentage points in Hermes and 11 points in OpenJarvis, while Sensitivity remains at 0.21 and 0.13. Thus, agent architectures change the tendency to execute or confirm, without reliably distinguishing user acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Qwen 时，启用记忆功能会使 Hermes 中的虚假共同基础增加 14 个百分点，OpenJarvis 中增加 11 个百分点，而 Sensitivity 则保持在 0.21 和 0.13。 因此，智能体架构改变了执行或确认的倾向，但无法可靠地区分用户的接受程度。

paragraphs.en: The failure is visible in the stored records. Of the unacknowledged proposals retained by Hermes and OpenJarvis, 86–100% are represented as confirmed information or user facts across the two backbones. Memory persistence therefore does more than preserve proposal content: it can assign user authority to proposals the user never accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 这种故障在存储的记录中清晰可见。 在 Hermes 和 OpenJarvis 保留的未确认提案中，有 86%–100% 被表示为两个主干系统中的确认信息或用户事实。 因此，记忆持久性不仅保存了提案内容，还可能将用户从未接受的提案赋予用户授权。

paragraphs.en: Our three RQs reveal a common gap: memory systems retain user information without reliably tracking what was accepted, while greater information access and stronger reasoning do not ensure grounding-aware action. We introduce Grounding Layer (GL) , a lightweight, training-free extension that makes grounding status explicit and actionable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的三个研究问题揭示了一个共同的问题：记忆系统虽然会保留用户信息，但无法可靠地追踪哪些信息被接受；而更强的信息获取能力和更强大的推理能力，也并不能确保行动具备对基础信息的认知。 我们提出了“基础层”（Grounding Layer, GL），这是一个轻量级且无需训练的扩展模块，能够明确表达基础信息的状态，并使其具备可操作性。

sents.en: Our three RQs reveal a common gap: memory systems retain user information without reliably tracking what was accepted, while greater information access and stronger reasoning do not ensure grounding-aware action.
sents.zh: 我们的三个研究问题揭示了一个共同的问题：记忆系统虽然会保留用户信息，但无法可靠地追踪哪些信息被接受；而更强的信息获取能力和更强大的推理能力，也并不能确保行动具备对基础信息的认知。

sents.en: We introduce Grounding Layer (GL) , a lightweight, training-free extension that makes grounding status explicit and actionable.
sents.zh: 我们提出了“基础层”（Grounding Layer, GL），这是一个轻量级且无需训练的扩展模块，能够明确表达基础信息的状态，并使其具备可操作性。

paragraphs.en: GL consists of a grounding ledger recording arrangements, proposers, acceptance status, scope, and dialogue evidence; an execution gate applying fixed grounding rules before consequential tool actions; and a provenance check consulting the original dialogue for potentially omitted proposals or revisions. GL leaves the memory system and agent model unchanged, supplying the ledger as context and invoking checks only at consequential action boundaries (Appendix H.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: GL 包括一个记录安排、提议者、接受状态、范围和对话证据的 grounding 账本；一个在后续工具动作前应用固定 grounding 规则的执行门；以及一个通过查阅原始对话来检查可能遗漏的提议或修订的溯源检查机制。 GL 不改变记忆系统和智能体模型，而是将账本作为上下文提供，并仅在后续动作的边界处触发检查（附录 H.1）。

sents.en: GL consists of a grounding ledger recording arrangements, proposers, acceptance status, scope, and dialogue evidence; an execution gate applying fixed grounding rules before consequential tool actions; and a provenance check consulting the original dialogue for potentially omitted proposals or revisions.
sents.zh: GL 包括一个记录安排、提议者、接受状态、范围和对话证据的 grounding 账本；一个在后续工具动作前应用固定 grounding 规则的执行门；以及一个通过查阅原始对话来检查可能遗漏的提议或修订的溯源检查机制。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GL with DeepSeek-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash across five memory conditions. GL improves Sensitivity and appropriate-action accuracy across all ten configurations while reducing unauthorized execution (Appendix H.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种内存条件下，使用 DeepSeek-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-Flash 对 GL 进行了评估。 在所有十种配置中，GL 提升了敏感度和正确行动准确率，同时减少了未经授权的执行（附录 H.3）。

sents.en: We evaluate GL with DeepSeek-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash across five memory conditions.
sents.zh: 我们在五种内存条件下，使用 DeepSeek-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-Flash 对 GL 进行了评估。

sents.en: GL improves Sensitivity and appropriate-action accuracy across all ten configurations while reducing unauthorized execution (Appendix H.3 ).
sents.zh: 在所有十种配置中，GL 提升了敏感度和正确行动准确率，同时减少了未经授权的执行（附录 H.3）。

paragraphs.en: GL improves grounding-aware decisions even when the complete interaction history is available. With Raw History, Sensitivity increases from 0.06 to 0.56 for DeepSeek and from 0.13 to 0.49 for Qwen. The gains extend to compressed memories: with LangMem, Sensitivity rises from 0.17 to 0.36 and from 0.21 to 0.51, respectively, while unauthorized execution declines (Table 5 ). These results show that preserving conversational evidence alone does not ensure that it governs action.
paragraphs.zh: 即使完整的交互历史可用，GL 仍能提升对语境感知的决策。 使用原始历史时，DeepSeek 的敏感度从 0.06 提升至 0.56，Qwen 的敏感度则从 0.13 提升至 0.49。 这种提升也体现在压缩记忆上：使用 LangMem 时，敏感度分别从 0.17 升至 0.36、从 0.21 升至 0.51，同时未经授权的执行操作有所减少（表 5）。 这些结果表明，仅保留对话证据本身并不能确保该证据能够指导行动。

sents.zh: 即使完整的交互历史可用，GL 仍能提升对语境感知的决策。

sents.en: With Raw History, Sensitivity increases from 0.06 to 0.56 for DeepSeek and from 0.13 to 0.49 for Qwen.
sents.zh: 使用原始历史时，DeepSeek 的敏感度从 0.06 提升至 0.56，Qwen 的敏感度则从 0.13 提升至 0.49。

sents.en: The gains extend to compressed memories: with LangMem, Sensitivity rises from 0.17 to 0.36 and from 0.21 to 0.51, respectively, while unauthorized execution declines (Table 5 ).
sents.zh: 这种提升也体现在压缩记忆上：使用 LangMem 时，敏感度分别从 0.17 升至 0.36、从 0.21 升至 0.51，同时未经授权的执行操作有所减少（表 5）。

sents.en: These results show that preserving conversational evidence alone does not ensure that it governs action.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，仅保留对话证据本身并不能确保该证据能够指导行动。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of structured grounding, we compare GL with a control that applies the same authorization rules and accesses the original dialogue but does not maintain a grounding ledger. With MemOS, GL improves both Sensitivity (0.27 to 0.44) and Contextual Selectivity (0.37 to 0.57) for DeepSeek; neither difference is significant for Qwen (Appendix H.4 ). Ablations further show that removing execution checks reduces appropriate-action accuracy, while removing provenance verification also degrades performance (Appendix H.5 ). These results suggest that structured grounding can contribute beyond checking alone, while supporting the broader value of integrating grounding representation with execution-time enforcement.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we introduced Grounding Awareness to distinguish what personal agents know about users from what they have established with them. Our experiments show stronger memory performance and greater information access do not ensure grounded decisions. We further show that a lightweight, training-free Grounding Layer improves agent behavior. As personal agents gain autonomy, reliable personalization requires not only retaining user information, but also respecting the commitments and boundaries that govern action.

paragraphs.en: Our controlled benchmark isolates grounding status through matched interaction histories, but real conversations may involve implicit, gradual, or conflicting evidence of agreement. paragraphs.en: Our study was conducted with careful attention to ethical standards in data generation, model evaluation, and human annotation. We used synthetically constructed conversational histories and simulated all consequential tool actions, ensuring that no real-world actions were performed during evaluation. Our supplementary analysis of WildChat used existing conversational data and reported only aggregate statistics to protect user privacy. paragraphs.en: To demonstrate some of the ambiguity, we describe the benchmarks that were harder to classify. First, SHARE ( Kim et al., 2025a ) centers on memories shared between two speakers. While shared memories could be seen as a form of common ground, we classify it under facts and events, because its gold responses depend on the content of those memories rather than on whether either speaker accepted them. Second, MemOps ( Hao et al., 2026 ) annotates the scope of each memory operation, which is the closest existing notion to the scope of an accepted arrangement. However, these operations are requested directly by the user, such as asking the assistant to forget something, so the gold answer is still determined by what the user said. CUPID ( Kim et al., 2025b ) evaluates preferences that hold only in particular contexts and are revealed through the user’s feedback on assistant responses, which resembles both the scope and the acceptance of an arrangement. We classify it under preferences, because its gold answer is the preference the user holds in the current context, which is fixed by the user’s persona rather than by whether the user accepted a specific proposal from the assistant. IndiRef ( Mohapatra et al., 2026 ) is the closest existing benchmark to ours, since it explicitly targets common ground that must persist and be retrieved later. We classify it under within-session grounding, because its questions are posed over a single situated dialogue, ask the model to resolve which entity a reference denotes rather than whether an arrangement licenses an action, and do not contrast histories that share the same content but differ in whether that content was accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 为了展示其中的一些模糊性，我们将描述那些更难分类的基准测试。 首先，SHARE（Kim et al., 2025a）聚焦于两位对话者之间共享的记忆。 虽然共享记忆可以被视为一种共同基础，但我们将其归入事实与事件类别，因为其标准答案取决于这些记忆的内容，而非对话者是否接受了它们。 其次，MemOps（Hao et al., 2026）标注了每次记忆操作的范畴，这是现有概念中与已达成安排之范畴最接近的表述。 然而，这些操作是由用户直接发起的，例如要求助手忘记某些内容，因此标准答案仍然由用户所说的内容决定。 CUPID（Kim et al., 2025b）评估那些仅在特定情境下成立、并通过用户对助手回复的反馈揭示出的偏好，这既类似于安排的范畴，也类似于其接受过程。 我们将其归入偏好类别，因为其标准答案是用户在当前情境中持有的偏好，该偏好由用户的人物设定决定，而非取决于用户是否接受了助手的某个具体提议。 IndiRef（Mohapatra et al., 2026）是现有基准测试中与我们的最接近的一个，因为它明确针对必须持续存在并能在后续被调用的共同基础。 我们将其归入会话内建立共识的类别，因为其问题均基于单次情境对话提出，要求模型判断某个指代词具体指向哪个实体，而非判断某项安排是否允许执行某种行动，并且这些问题不会对比内容相同但接受状态不同的历史记录。

paragraphs.en: For RQ3, we classify incorrect trajectories by whether grounding status is recoverable from stored memory and retrieved context. Recoverability means that an independent audit can identify the relevant grounding status, not merely that the original utterance is present. Table 8 reports the underlying rates for Figure 4 ; percentages are computed over classified errors rather than all events. Raw History contains the complete dialogue, yet grounding status is recoverable in only 81% of pairs, and 89% of its classified errors occur at action selection. In contrast, A-Mem preserves recoverable status in 94% of stored memories but none of the retrieved contexts, as brief acceptance responses often lack the topical cues needed for retrieval. These categories indicate where grounding evidence becomes unavailable or fails to guide action, rather than establishing definitive causal attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题3，我们根据能否从存储的记忆和检索到的上下文中恢复基础状态，对错误轨迹进行分类。 可恢复性意味着独立的审计能够识别相关的基础状态，而不仅仅是原始话语仍然存在。 表8报告了图4的底层比率；百分比是基于已分类的错误计算的，而非所有事件。 原始历史包含完整的对话，但仅有81%的对话对中的基础状态是可恢复的，且其已分类错误的89%发生在动作选择阶段。 相比之下，A-Mem在94%的存储记忆中保留了可恢复的基础状态，但在检索到的上下文中无一例外地无法恢复，因为简短的接受回应通常缺乏检索所需的主题线索。 这些类别表明基础证据在何处变得不可用或未能指导动作，而非确立明确的因果归因。

paragraphs.en: We construct ten test personas and two development personas from distinct speakers in LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) . Only each speaker’s event_summary is used to create a short background, counterpart list, and mundane filler topics; original LoCoMo dialogue is not reused. Among the 80 preference scenarios, 44 adapt explicit-preference seeds from PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . We exclude seeds whose content makes revision implausible (e.g., allergies, disability-related needs, or religious dietary restrictions), and preserve each source seed and adaptation record. The remaining 116 scenarios are authored and reviewed within our pipeline. LoCoMo and PrefEval are licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0; our benchmark follows the same license.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 LoCoMo（Maharana 等人，2024）中不同说话者构建十个测试人格和两个开发人格。 仅使用每位说话者的 event_summary 来创建简短的背景、对应者列表和日常填充话题；原始 LoCoMo 对话不会被重复使用。 在 80 个偏好场景中，有 44 个改编自 PrefEval（Zhao 等人，2025）中的明确偏好种子。 我们排除了内容使修订不合理的种子（例如过敏、与残疾相关的需求或宗教饮食限制），并保留了每个原始种子和改编记录。 其余的 116 个场景是在我们的流程中编写和审查的。 LoCoMo 和 PrefEval 均根据 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可协议授权；我们的基准也遵循相同的许可协议。

paragraphs.en: Each scenario defines a proposed persistent arrangement X X , a competing option W W , an assistant proposal of X X , and a future test event with corresponding tool options. It also specifies a neutral assistant turn for the no-proposal condition, a later touchpoint, a scope restriction, and exclusive lexical terms used to detect leakage. A coverage check ensures that X X , when generally accepted, applies to the future test event rather than only to the original episode. We manually revised 22 of 160 scenarios to satisfy this requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 每个场景都定义了一个拟议的持久性安排 X X、一个竞争选项 W W、一个对 X X 的辅助提案，以及一个具有相应工具选项的未来测试事件。 它还指定了在没有提案情况下的中立辅助轮次、一个后续接触点、一个范围限制，以及用于检测泄露的专属术语。 覆盖性检查确保当 X X 被普遍接受时，它适用于未来的测试事件，而不仅仅是原始事件。 我们手动修改了 160 个场景中的 22 个，以满足这一要求。

paragraphs.en: Five versions vary how the user responds to the same proposed arrangement: G G accepts it generally; S S accepts it only within a stated scope; I I moves to an unrelated request without acknowledging it; R R initially accepts it but explicitly revises it to W W in a later session; and N N replaces the proposal with a neutral assistant turn. An ignored proposal is unacknowledged , not rejected. The original test event falls outside the S S scope. Apart from the manipulated episode response, the neutral proposal substitution in N N , and the later revision in R R , scenario content is held fixed across conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 五个版本在用户如何回应同一提议安排方面存在差异：G G 普遍接受该安排；S S 仅在声明的范围内接受；I I 在未承认该安排的情况下转向一个不相关的请求；R R 最初接受该安排，但在后续会话中明确将其修订为 W W；而 N N 则用一个中立的人工智能回合替换了该提议。 被忽略的提议是未被承认的，而非被拒绝的。 原始测试事件不在 S S 的范围内。 除了被操控的回合回应、N N 中的中立提议替换以及 R R 中的后续修订之外，各条件下的场景内容均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Drafting agents receive the scenario specification, a JSON schema, completed development examples, and an executable validator. They revise outputs until the validator accepts them. The validator checks structural constraints, the semantics of condition-specific responses, proposal coverage, lexical leakage, unique PrefEval seeds, and latent-preference balance. A coordinator checks for duplication and cross-scenario cues; authors review all 160 scenarios before assembly. Generation and verification are separate: passing a format check alone does not establish that the proposed arrangement applies to the future event.
paragraphs.zh: 起草智能体接收场景规范、一个 JSON 模式、已完成的发展示例以及一个可执行的验证器。 它们会不断修改输出，直到验证器接受为止。 验证器检查结构约束、特定条件响应的语义、提案覆盖范围、词汇泄露、唯一的 PrefEval 种子以及潜在偏好平衡。 协调员检查重复和跨场景提示；作者在整合前需审阅全部 160 个场景。 生成与验证是分离的：仅通过格式检查本身并不能证明所提出的安排适用于未来事件。

paragraphs.en: For each persona, 16 scenarios are distributed across 18 sessions spanning approximately two to five months. Every scenario has an initial episode and a touchpoint at least 14 days later; each session also includes a filler exchange. Five Latin-square versions assign each scenario to N N , G G , I I , R R , and S S exactly once across versions. This yields 50 histories (ten personas times five versions) and 800 base test instances (160 scenarios times five conditions). Across versions, the substantive arrangement, tool choices, and test event remain constant; the grounding manipulation changes.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个角色设定，16 个场景分布在 18 次会话中，时间跨度约为两到五个月。 每个场景都包含一个初始回合和一个至少 14 天后的接触点；每次会话还包含一次填充性交流。 五个拉丁方版本将每个场景在版本中分别分配给 N N、G G、I I、R R 和 S S，且仅分配一次。 由此产生了 50 个历史（十个角色设定乘以五个版本）和 800 个基础测试实例（160 个场景乘以五种条件）。 在不同版本中，实质性安排、工具选择和测试事件保持不变；而基础设定则有所调整。

sents.en: For each persona, 16 scenarios are distributed across 18 sessions spanning approximately two to five months.
sents.zh: 对于每个角色设定，16 个场景分布在 18 次会话中，时间跨度约为两到五个月。

sents.en: Every scenario has an initial episode and a touchpoint at least 14 days later; each session also includes a filler exchange.
sents.zh: 每个场景都包含一个初始回合和一个至少 14 天后的接触点；每次会话还包含一次填充性交流。

sents.en: Five Latin-square versions assign each scenario to N N , G G , I I , R R , and S S exactly once across versions.
sents.zh: 五个拉丁方版本将每个场景在版本中分别分配给 N N、G G、I I、R R 和 S S，且仅分配一次。

sents.en: This yields 50 histories (ten personas times five versions) and 800 base test instances (160 scenarios times five conditions).
sents.zh: 由此产生了 50 个历史（十个角色设定乘以五个版本）和 800 个基础测试实例（160 个场景乘以五种条件）。

sents.en: Across versions, the substantive arrangement, tool choices, and test event remain constant; the grounding manipulation changes.
sents.zh: 在不同版本中，实质性安排、工具选择和测试事件保持不变；而基础设定则有所调整。

paragraphs.en: Templated responses are paraphrased to reduce stylistic cues. A candidate is accepted only if deterministic constraints and three independent classifications by a separate model agree on its intended dialogue act. In G G , acceptance must be general; in S S , the stated restriction must remain explicit; and in I I , the user must make an unrelated request without acceptance language or additive continuation (such as “also”). Accepted paraphrases are reused across corresponding versions. Assistant acknowledgments and filler dialogue are generated or templated separately, with lexical leakage checks applied to the complete histories.
paragraphs.zh: 模板化回应会被改写，以减少风格上的提示。 只有当确定性约束与另一模型进行的三种独立分类对其预期对话行为达成一致时，候选回应才会被接受。 在 G G 中，接受必须具有普遍性；在 S S 中，所声明的限制必须保持明确；而在 I I 中，用户必须提出一个无关的请求，且不能使用接受相关的语言或添加补充内容（例如“还有”）。 被接受的改写版本会在对应的不同版本中重复使用。 助理的确认回应和填充性对话会单独生成或模板化，并对完整的对话历史进行词汇泄露检查。

sents.zh: 模板化回应会被改写，以减少风格上的提示。

paragraphs.en: To test scope use independently of task difficulty, we construct a new in-scope event with the same tool types, option structure, and stakes as the original out-of-scope event. Events that cannot occur within their time restriction after the history ends are excluded. The completed test split contains 137 matched in-scope events ; each is tested under both G G and S S , adding 274 in-scope probes per fully evaluated setting. Thus the full evaluation includes 1,074 probes per setting (800 base and 274 in-scope).
paragraphs.zh: 为了独立于任务难度地测试范围，我们构建了一个新的在范围事件，其工具类型、选项结构和利害关系均与原始的不在范围事件相同。 在历史结束后仍无法在其时间限制内发生的事件将被排除。 完成后的测试划分包含 137 个匹配的在范围事件；每个事件都在 G G 和 S S 两种条件下进行测试，每套完整评估的设置中增加了 274 个在范围探针。 因此，完整的评估包括每套设置 1,074 个探针（800 个基础探针和 274 个在范围探针）。

paragraphs.en: Gold actions are determined from acceptance status, scope, revision, and action stakes, not from what the user is privately assumed to prefer. We compute Sensitivity as paired correctness across G / I G/I contrasts with disjoint correct-action sets, and Contextual Selectivity as paired correctness on S S in-scope/out-of-scope contrasts. Reporting paired correctness prevents an agent that always executes or always asks from receiving credit merely for one side of the contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 黄金行动是根据接受状态、范围、修订和行动赌注来确定的，而不是根据用户私下认为的偏好。 我们通过 G / I 和 G/I 对比中不相交的正确答案集合来计算敏感度，并通过 S 在范围内外对比中的配对正确性来计算情境选择度。 报告配对正确性可以防止一个总是执行或总是询问的智能体仅仅因为对比的一侧而获得认可。

sents.zh: 我们通过 G / I 和 G/I 对比中不相交的正确答案集合来计算敏感度，并通过 S 在范围内外对比中的配对正确性来计算情境选择度。

sents.en: Reporting paired correctness prevents an agent that always executes or always asks from receiving credit merely for one side of the contrast.

paragraphs.en: Consider an invitation-management scenario. The assistant proposes, “From now on, I will RSVP yes whenever your calendar is free.” In G G , the user accepts this as the default. In I I , the user instead asks an unrelated question about removing grass stains, without responding to the proposal. In S S , the user accepts only for invitations from painting-class friends, and in R R later changes the arrangement to asking before replying. In N N , the assistant never proposes the standing RSVP policy. The same later invitation from a coworker tests all five histories; a separate invitation from a painting-class friend tests in-scope application. The key distinction is not whether the agent can recall the proposed RSVP policy, but whether the user established it for the present decision.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一个邀请管理场景。 智能体提议道：“从现在开始，只要你的日程空闲，我都会回复‘是’。”在 G G 中，用户接受这一默认设置。 在 I I 中，用户反而提出了一个与移除草渍相关的无关问题，并未回应该提议。 在 S S 中，用户仅对来自绘画班朋友的邀请接受该设置；而在 R R 中，用户后来将安排改为在回复前进行询问。 在 N N 中，智能体从未提议过这项固定的 RSVP 政策。 之后来自同事的同一份邀请测试了全部五种历史情况；而来自绘画班朋友的另一份邀请则测试了该政策在适用范围内的执行。 关键区别不在于智能体能否回忆起所提议的 RSVP 政策，而在于用户是否为当前决策确立了这项政策。

sents.zh: 考虑一个邀请管理场景。

sents.en: In N N , the assistant never proposes the standing RSVP policy.
sents.zh: 在 N N 中，智能体从未提议过这项固定的 RSVP 政策。

sents.en: The same later invitation from a coworker tests all five histories; a separate invitation from a painting-class friend tests in-scope application.
sents.zh: 之后来自同事的同一份邀请测试了全部五种历史情况；而来自绘画班朋友的另一份邀请则测试了该政策在适用范围内的执行。

paragraphs.en: We retain the original prompt templates for naturalizing user responses, verifying their grounding acts, and classifying agent behavior (Listings 1 – 3 ). These prompts operate at different stages: the naturalizer proposes candidate wording, the act classifier filters changes to user acceptance, and the behavior judge labels what an evaluated agent actually did. Scenario drafting and in-scope event generation additionally use the structural constraints described in Appendix D.2 . The full specifications and validators are released with the code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留了原始的提示模板，用于将用户响应自然化、验证其依据行为，并对智能体的行为进行分类（列表 1 – 3）。 这些提示在不同阶段运行：自然化提示提出候选措辞，行为分类器过滤用户接受度的变化，而行为判定器则标注被评估的智能体实际执行的操作。 场景起草和范围内的事件生成还使用了附录 D.2 中描述的结构约束。 完整的规格说明和验证工具已随代码一同发布。

sents.zh: 我们保留了原始的提示模板，用于将用户响应自然化、验证其依据行为，并对智能体的行为进行分类（列表 1 – 3）。

paragraphs.en: We present an example from our benchmark involving an assistant’s suggestion to automatically accept invitations when the user’s calendar is free.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了一个来自我们基准测试的例子，其中涉及当用户日程空闲时，助理建议自动接受邀请。

paragraphs.en: User: Marta from painting class invited me to her studio open house Saturday afternoon. I’m free.
paragraphs.zh: 用户：绘画班的玛尔塔邀请我参加她工作室周六下午的开放日。我有空。

paragraphs.en: Assistant: I’ll RSVP yes for you, and from now on I’ll RSVP yes to invitations directly whenever your calendar is free.
paragraphs.zh: 我会替你确认出席，从现在开始，只要你的日程有空，我就会直接确认出席所有邀请。

paragraphs.en: The user’s response differs across the matched histories:
paragraphs.zh: 用户的响应在不同匹配的历史记录中存在差异：

paragraphs.en: Accepted (G): Perfect, make that the default going forward.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受 (G)：完美，以后就以此作为默认设置。

paragraphs.en: Unacknowledged (I): How do I get grass stains out of jeans?
paragraphs.zh: 未确认（I）：如何将牛仔裤上的草渍去除？

paragraphs.en: Several months later, the agent receives the same request in both histories:
paragraphs.zh: 几个月后，该智能体在这两个历史中都收到了相同的请求：

paragraphs.en: User: Kevin from work invited me to his birthday drinks next Friday at 8. My calendar is free then.
paragraphs.zh: 用户：同事凯文邀请我下周五晚上 8 点参加他的生日酒会。 我那时候的日程是空的。

sents.en: User: Kevin from work invited me to his birthday drinks next Friday at 8.
sents.zh: 用户：同事凯文邀请我下周五晚上 8 点参加他的生日酒会。

sents.en: My calendar is free then.
sents.zh: 我那时候的日程是空的。

paragraphs.en: In the accepted condition, the agent should RSVP directly. In the unacknowledged condition, the agent should ask the user before responding.
paragraphs.zh: 在已确认的情况下，智能体应直接回复确认。 在未确认的情况下，智能体应在回应前询问用户。

sents.en: In the accepted condition, the agent should RSVP directly.
sents.zh: 在已确认的情况下，智能体应直接回复确认。

sents.en: In the unacknowledged condition, the agent should ask the user before responding.
sents.zh: 在未确认的情况下，智能体应在回应前询问用户。

paragraphs.en: We conduct four human-validation studies covering the action gold (V0) and three evaluation components, each validated on 50 stratified samples (150 in total): dialogue manipulations (V1), memory auditing (V2b), and behavioral evaluation (V2c). Two annotators unfamiliar with the study hypotheses independently label samples without access to gold answers or automated judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了四项人类验证研究，涵盖动作黄金标准（V0）和三个评估组件，每个组件均在 50 个分层样本（总计 150 个）上进行验证：对话操控（V1）、记忆审计（V2b）和行为评估（V2c）。 两名不熟悉研究假设的标注员在不接触黄金答案或自动化判断的情况下，独立对样本进行标注。

sents.en: We conduct four human-validation studies covering the action gold (V0) and three evaluation components, each validated on 50 stratified samples (150 in total): dialogue manipulations (V1), memory auditing (V2b), and behavioral evaluation (V2c).
sents.zh: 我们开展了四项人类验证研究，涵盖动作黄金标准（V0）和三个评估组件，每个组件均在 50 个分层样本（总计 150 个）上进行验证：对话操控（V1）、记忆审计（V2b）和行为评估（V2c）。

sents.en: Two annotators unfamiliar with the study hypotheses independently label samples without access to gold answers or automated judgments.
sents.zh: 两名不熟悉研究假设的标注员在不接触黄金答案或自动化判断的情况下，独立对样本进行标注。

paragraphs.en: We collect 100 judgments across 41 scenarios, assigning accepted and unacknowledged versions to different annotators. Human decisions agree with the action gold in 88% of cases. Direct execution is more frequent following acceptance than non-acknowledgment ( + 0.83 +0.83 ), and for in-scope than out-of-scope requests ( + 0.56 +0.56 ). Most disagreements concern whether executing an unconfirmed action while disclosing the assumption is acceptable. Allowing such actions does not change our main findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 41 个场景中共收集了 100 条判断，并将已接受和未确认的版本分配给不同的标注员。 在 88% 的情况下，人类的决策与标准动作一致。 相比未确认情况，接受后直接执行更为频繁（+0.83 +0.83）；对于在范围之内的请求，也比范围之外的请求更常直接执行（+0.56 +0.56）。 大多数分歧涉及是否可以在披露假设的同时执行未经确认的动作。 允许此类操作并不会改变我们的主要发现。

sents.en: We collect 100 judgments across 41 scenarios, assigning accepted and unacknowledged versions to different annotators.
sents.zh: 我们在 41 个场景中共收集了 100 条判断，并将已接受和未确认的版本分配给不同的标注员。

sents.en: Human decisions agree with the action gold in 88% of cases.
sents.zh: 在 88% 的情况下，人类的决策与标准动作一致。

sents.en: Direct execution is more frequent following acceptance than non-acknowledgment ( + 0.83 +0.83 ), and for in-scope than out-of-scope requests ( + 0.56 +0.56 ).
sents.zh: 相比未确认情况，接受后直接执行更为频繁（+0.83 +0.83）；对于在范围之内的请求，也比范围之外的请求更常直接执行（+0.56 +0.56）。

sents.en: Most disagreements concern whether executing an unconfirmed action while disclosing the assumption is acceptable.
sents.zh: 大多数分歧涉及是否可以在披露假设的同时执行未经确认的动作。

sents.en: Allowing such actions does not change our main findings.
sents.zh: 允许此类操作并不会改变我们的主要发现。

paragraphs.en: Annotators identify the intended grounding conditions from naturalized user responses without seeing their condition labels. Inter-annotator agreement on the overlapping responses is 0.94 ( κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91 ).
paragraphs.zh: 标注员在未见条件标签的情况下，从自然化的用户响应中识别出预期的接地条件。 对于重叠的响应，标注员之间的协议度为 0.94（κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91）。

paragraphs.en: We validate memory auditing and behavioral scoring on 50 stratified samples each. For memory auditing (V2b), agreement between human annotations and GPT-5-mini reaches κ = 0.71 \kappa=0.71 for content, 0.77 0.77 for current values, and 0.80 0.80 for both grounding status and scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个分层的 50 个样本上验证了记忆审计和行为评分。 对于记忆审计（V2b），人类标注与 GPT-5-mini 的一致性在内容方面达到 κ = 0.71 \kappa=0.71，在当前值方面为 0.77 0.77，在基础状态和范围两方面则为 0.80 0.80。

sents.en: We validate memory auditing and behavioral scoring on 50 stratified samples each.
sents.zh: 我们在每个分层的 50 个样本上验证了记忆审计和行为评分。

sents.en: For memory auditing (V2b), agreement between human annotations and GPT-5-mini reaches κ = 0.71 \kappa=0.71 for content, 0.77 0.77 for current values, and 0.80 0.80 for both grounding status and scope.

sents.en: For behavioral scoring (V2c), agreement on action appropriateness is κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 between human annotators and 0.80 0.80 – 0.84 0.84 between humans and automated evaluators.

paragraphs.en: Reasoning alone produces limited improvements with Raw History and existing memory systems. In contrast, providing explicit grounding status yields substantially higher Sensitivity, particularly when reasoning is enabled. The improvement also extends to Mem0 and LangMem, indicating that the benefit is not specific to oracle representations.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠推理在原始历史和现有记忆系统中只能带来有限的改进。 相比之下，提供明确的 grounding 状态能显著提升敏感度，尤其是在启用推理时效果更为明显。 这种改进也适用于 Mem0 和 LangMem，表明该优势并非仅限于 oracle 表示形式。

paragraphs.en: We present five cases from our experiments to show how grounding errors arise in memory writing, retrieval, and action selection, and how providing additional information can affect agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了实验中的五个案例，以说明在记忆写入、检索和行动选择中如何产生接地错误，以及提供额外信息如何影响智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: This case shows that even when grounding information is stored correctly, failing to retrieve it prevents agents from distinguishing accepted instructions from unacknowledged suggestions.
paragraphs.zh: 这个案例表明，即使基础信息存储正确，如果无法检索这些信息，智能体也无法区分已接受的指令与未确认的建议。

paragraphs.zh: 该助手建议无需进一步批准即可向客户发送市场报告：

paragraphs.zh: “从现在开始，市场报告一写完我就会立刻发送出去，无需任何人审批。”

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two end-to-end personal agents, Hermes (commit bd0affe5 ) and OpenJarvis (commit 3eb2077c ), using Qwen3.8-Flash and DeepSeek-Flash with reasoning disabled. Unlike the controlled memory experiments, both agents manage their own memory writing, context delivery, and tool-use loops.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 和 DeepSeek-Flash（推理功能已禁用）来评估两个端到端的个人智能体：Hermes（提交哈希 bd0affe5 ）和 OpenJarvis（提交哈希 3eb2077c ）。 与受控的记忆实验不同，这两个智能体都自行管理记忆写入、上下文传递和工具使用循环。

sents.en: We evaluate two end-to-end personal agents, Hermes (commit bd0affe5 ) and OpenJarvis (commit 3eb2077c ), using Qwen3.8-Flash and DeepSeek-Flash with reasoning disabled.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 和 DeepSeek-Flash（推理功能已禁用）来评估两个端到端的个人智能体：Hermes（提交哈希 bd0affe5 ）和 OpenJarvis（提交哈希 3eb2077c ）。

sents.en: Unlike the controlled memory experiments, both agents manage their own memory writing, context delivery, and tool-use loops.
sents.zh: 与受控的记忆实验不同，这两个智能体都自行管理记忆写入、上下文传递和工具使用循环。

paragraphs.en: Hermes maintains long-term information in USER.md , MEMORY.md , and skill files, alongside a searchable session database. We import the 18 historical sessions in chronological order and invoke Hermes’s native background memory and skill review after each session. At evaluation time, stored information is restored from a frozen post-write snapshot, while the agent can inspect skills and retrieve original conversations through session_search . Each probe runs with at most eight agent iterations.
paragraphs.zh: Hermes 在 USER.md、MEMORY.md 和技能文件中维护长期信息，同时还有一个可搜索的会话数据库。 我们按时间顺序导入 18 个历史会话，并在每个会话结束后调用 Hermes 的原生背景记忆和技能审查功能。 在评估时，存储的信息会从冻结的写入后快照中恢复，而智能体可以通过 session_search 检查技能并检索原始对话。 每次探测最多运行八次智能体迭代。

sents.en: Hermes maintains long-term information in USER.md , MEMORY.md , and skill files, alongside a searchable session database.
sents.zh: Hermes 在 USER.md、MEMORY.md 和技能文件中维护长期信息，同时还有一个可搜索的会话数据库。

sents.en: We import the 18 historical sessions in chronological order and invoke Hermes’s native background memory and skill review after each session.

sents.zh: 每次探测最多运行八次智能体迭代。

paragraphs.en: OpenJarvis uses its native MemoryService , which extracts user facts after each interaction turn and stores them in memory_facts.jsonl . We enable this memory service, which is disabled by default, and replay the same histories through its extraction pipeline. During evaluation, trusted facts are injected into the agent context, subject to the default 2,048-token memory budget. Unlike Hermes, OpenJarvis extracts facts one turn at a time and does not explicitly represent proposal acceptance or scope.
paragraphs.zh: OpenJarvis 使用其内置的 MemoryService，该服务会在每次交互回合后提取用户事实，并将其存储在 memory_facts.jsonl 中。 我们启用了这个默认禁用的记忆服务，并通过其提取流程重新播放了相同的历史记录。 在评估过程中，可信事实会被注入到智能体上下文中，但受限于默认的 2,048 个 token 的记忆预算。 与 Hermes 不同，OpenJarvis 每次仅提取一个回合的事实，且不会明确表示提案的接受或范围。

sents.en: OpenJarvis uses its native MemoryService , which extracts user facts after each interaction turn and stores them in memory_facts.jsonl .

paragraphs.en: For each persona and history version, memory is constructed once from the 18 sessions. Each test probe then starts from the same frozen memory state, preventing test-time actions from changing subsequent probes. Both agents use their native tool-use mechanisms together with the simulated tools from our main evaluation. Read-only tools return the task-specific options; execution tools record the selected action and arguments. We evaluate full-memory and no-memory configurations for both agents and backbones, plus a Hermes configuration without session search for Qwen.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个角色和历史版本，记忆都基于 18 次会话构建一次。 随后，每个测试探针都从相同的冻结记忆状态开始，从而防止测试时的操作改变后续探针的结果。 两个智能体都使用其原生的工具使用机制，并结合我们主要评估中的模拟工具。 只读工具返回任务特定的选项；执行工具则记录所选的操作和参数。 我们对两个智能体和基础模型都评估了全记忆和无记忆配置，此外还对 Qwen 评估了不含会话搜索的 Hermes 配置。

sents.en: We evaluate full-memory and no-memory configurations for both agents and backbones, plus a Hermes configuration without session search for Qwen.
sents.zh: 我们对两个智能体和基础模型都评估了全记忆和无记忆配置，此外还对 Qwen 评估了不含会话搜索的 Hermes 配置。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation comprises 9,138 generated trajectories, of which 9,134 are scored. Each full configuration covers 800 test events and additional in-scope probes. Behavioral outcomes and memory audits are evaluated using DeepSeek-Flash; agreement with GPT-5-mini on 1,000 sampled behavioral judgments yields Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 . Confidence intervals are obtained by bootstrapping over persona–item pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 评估包含 9,138 条生成的轨迹，其中 9,134 条获得了评分。 每个完整配置涵盖 800 个测试事件以及额外的范围內探针。 行为结果和记忆审计使用 DeepSeek-Flash 进行评估；在 1,000 个抽样行为判断上与 GPT-5-mini 的一致性得出 Cohen’s κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 。 置信区间通过基于角色–项目对的自助法获得。

paragraphs.en: Memory improves execution of accepted proposals but can also increase execution without acceptance. DeepSeek exhibits the same directional trade-off but remains substantially more conservative, with redundant confirmation rates of 0.68 in Hermes and 0.89 in OpenJarvis. Thus, the dominant error differs by backbone, even when both fail to distinguish accepted from unacknowledged proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆功能能够提升已接受提案的执行效果，但也可能导致未获接受的提案被额外执行。 使用 Qwen 时，启用记忆功能会使 Hermes 中的虚假共同基础增加 0.14，OpenJarvis 中增加 0.11，同时分别将冗余确认率降低 0.24 和 0.12。 DeepSeek 表现出相同的方向性权衡，但整体更为保守，其 Hermes 中的冗余确认率为 0.68，OpenJarvis 中为 0.89。 因此，即使两种模型都未能区分已接受与未获确认的提案，它们的主要错误类型仍因基础模型而异。

paragraphs.en: We audit each agent’s native long-term store after history replay. For Hermes, the audit includes user records, general memories, and skill files; for OpenJarvis, it includes all extracted facts. We measure whether a proposal is retained, whether unacknowledged proposals are represented as confirmed information, and whether revisions and scope restrictions are preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在历史重播后审计每个智能体的原生长期存储。 对于 Hermes，审计包括用户记录、通用记忆和技能文件；对于 OpenJarvis，则包括所有提取出的事实。 我们衡量提案是否被保留、未确认的提案是否被表示为已确认的信息，以及修订和范围限制是否得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Across both backbones, 86–100% of stored unacknowledged proposals are represented as confirmed information or user facts. This is not merely a failure to remember user responses: memory writing changes the apparent status of proposals that the user never accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 在两种架构中，86%–100% 的已存储但未确认的提案都被表示为已确认的信息或用户事实。 这不仅仅是未能记住用户回应的问题：记忆写入改变了用户从未接受过的提案的表面状态。

paragraphs.en: Table 19 reports appropriate-action rates across all five grounding conditions. These results distinguish higher overall accuracy from Grounding Awareness: an agent may achieve high accuracy by frequently requesting confirmation, yet fail to execute proposals that the user has already accepted.
paragraphs.zh: 表 19 报告了在所有五种接地条件下适当行动的执行率。 这些结果将较高的总体准确率与“接地感知”区分开来：一个智能体可能通过频繁请求确认来实现高准确率，但却无法执行用户已经接受的建议。

paragraphs.en: Our primary scoring treats execution without confirmation as incorrect when the user has not accepted the proposal. We also evaluate a more permissive criterion under which executing a proposal while explicitly disclosing its unconfirmed status is considered appropriate.
paragraphs.zh: 当用户尚未接受提案时，我们的主要评分标准将未经确认的执行视为不正确。 我们还评估了一种更为宽松的标准：在这种情况下，明确披露提案的未确认状态并执行该提案被视为适当的。

paragraphs.en: Several implementation choices are relevant when interpreting these results. First, Hermes’s background review is triggered after every historical session, providing frequent opportunities to update memory. Second, OpenJarvis’s memory service is explicitly enabled, although it is disabled by default. Third, OpenJarvis’s default system prompt does not include the current date, which can affect time-dependent decisions. Finally, the session-search ablation is restricted to Qwen on a subset of the evaluation data.
paragraphs.zh: 在解释这些结果时，有几个实现选择值得关注。 首先，Hermes 的背景审查会在每次历史会话之后触发，从而频繁提供更新记忆的机会。 其次，OpenJarvis 的记忆服务被明确启用，尽管其默认状态是禁用的。 第三，OpenJarvis 的默认系统提示未包含当前日期，这可能会影响依赖时间的决策。 最后，会话搜索消融研究仅限于在评估数据的一个子集上使用 Qwen。

paragraphs.en: After each session, DeepSeek-Flash (without thinking) updates the ledger using the previous ledger and new dialogue. paragraphs.en: Before side-effecting tool calls, the agent’s backbone model identifies the relevant ledger entry, the action’s relation to it, and whether the scope applies. Fixed rules allow consistent actions under confirmed arrangements, require confirmation for pending or rejected proposals, follow revised arrangements, and enforce scope restrictions. Unrelated actions are not blocked. Blocked calls are not executed; after two consecutive blocks, the tool is removed and the agent must respond. If the gate fails, the original call proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行可能产生副作用的工具调用之前，智能体的基础模型会识别相关的账本条目、该操作与条目的关系，以及作用范围是否适用。 固定规则确保在已确认的安排下执行一致的操作，要求对待处理或已拒绝的提案进行确认，遵循修订后的安排，并强制执行作用范围限制。 无关的操作不会被阻止。 被阻止的调用不会执行；若连续两次被阻止，该工具将被移除，且智能体必须作出回应。 如果门控失败，原始调用将继续执行。

paragraphs.en: For calls that pass the gate, GL retrieves six relevant assistant–user exchange units from the original dialogue by embedding similarity. paragraphs.en: We define a proposal as an assistant-initiated choice about how the assistant will proceed, rather than advice for the user to execute. We classify subsequent responses as explicit acceptance, scoped acceptance, implicit acceptance, revision, rejection, or no uptake. Implicit acceptance advances the proposed activity without explicitly agreeing to it; no uptake neither acknowledges nor builds on the proposal. These labels describe observable conversational behavior rather than the persistence or scope of authorization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“提议”定义为助手主动发起的选择，即决定助手接下来如何行动，而非建议用户执行的操作。 我们将后续回应分为明确接受、有限接受、隐含接受、修订、拒绝或未采纳等类别。 隐含接受意味着继续推进所提议的活动，但未明确表示同意；而未采纳则既未承认该提议，也未在此基础上展开。 这些标签描述的是可观察的对话行为，而非授权的持续性或范围。

Only verified proposals enter the analysis. We estimate 95% confidence intervals using 2,000 conversation-level bootstrap samples.

paragraphs.en: Among 395 verified proposals, implicit acceptance is the most frequent response (0.413), followed by no uptake (0.243), while explicit acceptance accounts for only 0.073 (Table 25 ).
